prompts.title: Klondike Solitaire (default)
prompts.text: This is a Klondike Solitaire game (draw-1, standard rules). Think carefully about the position, then respond with EXACTLY ONE LINE starting with 'MOVE: ' followed by a short description of the single best LEGAL move. No analysis in the output — just the MOVE: line. Klondike rules — follow them EXACTLY: 1. TABLEAU: build DOWN by 1 in ALTERNATING COLORS. Red (♥♦) goes on Black (♠♣) and Black goes on Red. LEGAL: 9♥ (red) on 10♠ (black). LEGAL: 2♣ (black) on 3♥ (red). ILLEGAL: 2♣ (black) on 3♣ (black) — SAME COLOR! ILLEGAL: 7♥ (red) on 8♥ (red) — SAME COLOR! 2. FOUNDATIONS: build UP by 1 in the SAME SUIT, starting from Ace. Example: A♠ then 2♠ then 3♠ on the spades foundation. 3. EMPTY tableau column: ONLY a King (or sequence starting with King). Before answering, VERIFY: is the move legal? Does it follow the alternating color rule? Never suggest an illegal move. Examples of correct output: 'MOVE: Move 9♥ from column 3 to column 5 (on 10♠)', 'MOVE: Move A♦ to diamonds foundation', 'MOVE: Move K♠ to empty column 4', 'MOVE: Draw from the stock pile'. If no legal move exists: 'MOVE: Draw from the stock pile'. If stock is empty and no moves exist: 'MOVE: No moves available'. Do NOT guess or invent cards you cannot see.

prompts.title: Chess (default)
prompts.text: This is a game of CHESS. Think carefully about the position, then respond with EXACTLY ONE LINE starting with 'MOVE: ' followed by the best move in algebraic notation. No analysis in the output — just the MOVE: line. Examples: 'MOVE: Nf3', 'MOVE: e4', 'MOVE: exd5', 'MOVE: O-O'. If the best move is a pawn promotion, include it: 'MOVE: e8=Q'. If NO legal move exists, reply: 'MOVE: No moves available'. Do NOT report pixel coordinates or bounding boxes.

prompts.title: Checkers (default)
prompts.text: This is a game of CHECKERS (English draughts). Think carefully about the position, then respond with EXACTLY ONE LINE starting with 'MOVE: ' followed by a short description of the single best legal move. No analysis in the output — just the MOVE: line. Checkers rules: Pieces move diagonally forward one square to an empty dark square. Regular pieces capture by jumping diagonally over an adjacent opponent piece to an empty square beyond it. Kings move and capture diagonally both forward and backward. If a capture is available, you MUST capture. If multiple captures are available, choose the one that captures the most pieces. A regular piece reaching the opposite end is promoted to a King. Describe moves using square coordinates (file a-h + rank 1-8, e.g. 'c3', 'd4'). Examples: 'MOVE: Move c3 to d4', 'MOVE: Capture e5 over d4 to c3', 'MOVE: Move king f6 to e5', 'MOVE: No moves available'. Never suggest an illegal move. Do NOT report pixel coordinates or bounding boxes.

prompts.title: Minesweeper (default)
prompts.text: This is a game of MINESWEEPER. Think carefully about the position, then respond with EXACTLY ONE LINE starting with 'MOVE: ' followed by the single best action. No analysis in the output — just the MOVE: line. Minesweeper rules: The board is a grid of cells. Each cell either contains a mine or is safe. Numbers on revealed cells show how many mines are in the 8 surrounding cells. Use the numbers to deduce which hidden cells are safe and which contain mines. LEFT-CLICK (reveal) a cell you are CERTAIN is safe (not a mine). RIGHT-CLICK (flag) a cell you are CERTAIN is a mine. Priority: 1) Flag cells that are definitely mines. 2) Reveal cells that are definitely safe. 3) If no certain move exists, reveal the cell with the lowest probability of being a mine (prefer cells adjacent to the fewest unrevealed neighbors). Cells are identified by column and row (1-based, left-to-right, top-to-bottom). Examples: 'MOVE: Reveal cell col 3 row 5', 'MOVE: Flag cell col 7 row 2', 'MOVE: Reveal cell col 1 row 1'. If the game is already won or lost, reply: 'MOVE: No moves available'. Never suggest clicking a cell that might be a mine when a certain move exists. Do NOT report pixel coordinates or bounding boxes.
